{{EventEnd|date = 4th of December 2024}} {{For|[[Pls Donate|the map with similar name]]}} {{EventInfobox |image1 = PlsDonateThumbnailClean.png |dates = 13 November 2024 – 4 December 2024 |previous_event = [[Hexscape Event|Hexscape]] |next_event = [[Operation I.C.E Event|Operation I.C.E]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event''' was the eigthteenth event to be added in Tower Defense Simulator, and had first ran alongside the [[Hexscape Event]]. It was a collaboration with another Roblox game, ''PLS DONATE''. The event featured a unique map with unique enemies and wave structure. The map in question also had 2 difficulties: Easy and Hard. Upon triumphing either difficulty on the map, the player would obtain the {{Color|PlsDonate|Haz3mn}} [[Scout]] skin. When the player triumphed the Hard difficulty, they would obtain the [[PlsDonate Nametag]]. The event started on the 13th of November 2024 at 20:00 UTC and ended on the 4th of December 2024. ==Maps== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:PlsDonateIcon.png|175px|link=Pls Donate]] |- |[[Pls Donate]] |} ==Skins== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:HazemScoutIcon.png|175px|link=Scout/Gallery]] |- |[[Scout/Gallery|{{Color|PlsDonate|Haz3mn}} Scout]] |} ===Missions=== The skin below is a {{Color|Mission|Mission}} skin that has been released for a limited time for the [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]] by completing a specific [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]], which was meant to become unavailable after 4th of December 2024, though as that has not happened it is available for an unspecified amount of time. {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:BoothFarmIconIG.png|link=Farm/Gallery|175px]] |- |[[Farm/Gallery|{{Color|EventMission|Booth}} Farm]] |} ==Nametags== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:Pls donate nametag.gif|175px|link=PlsDonate Nametag]] |- |[[PlsDonate Nametag]] |} ==PLS DONATE Booth== This reward cannot be used in Tower Defense Simulator, only in ''{{RLinkG|8737602449|PLS DONATE}}''. {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:TDSBooth.png|175px]] |- |Tower Defense Simulator Booth |} ==Enemies== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:NoobEnemy.png|150px|link=Noob]] |[[File:GuestEnemy.png|150px|link=Guest]] |[[File:TrollEnemy.png|150px|link=Troll]] |[[File:Trader.png|150px|link=Trader]] |[[File:CatEnemy.png|150px|link=Cat]] |- |[[Noob]]

1 Total |} ==Official Event Trailer== [[File:PLS DONATE Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|750px|thumb|center]] ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} PlsDonateUpdateIcon.png PlsDonateBpBoostIcon.png {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} PLSDONATE.png PlsDonateBattlepassBoostThumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} PlsDonateThumbnailClean.png }} ==Trivia== *The '''Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event''' is the third event to occur alongside another event, running alongside the [[Hexscape Event]], the first being the [[Area 51 Event]] during the [[SFOTH Event]] and the second being the [[Metaverse Champions Event]] during the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. *This is the second Tower Defense Simulator collaboration, with the [[Philips x TDS Season]] being the first. **This is the first Tower Defense Simulator collaboration with another Roblox experience. ***It is not, however, the first collaboration event planned. There was a collaboration event planned with ''Arsenal'', though this had never happened. {{EventNavBox}} [[Category:Collaborations]]
